payload.title: File:Besanosaurus PIMUZ T 4376 Meride.jpg
payload.description_html: A cast of specimens PIMUZ T 4376 (Besanosaurus, bottom) and PIMUZ T 4923 (Mixosaurus, top). The original slab was found in at Valle Stelle, an outcrop on Monte San Giorgio preserving the late Anisian (Middle Triassic) Besano Formation. Photo taken at the Museo dei fossili di Meride in Meride, Switzerland.
